{{Quote|My brother was out there somewhere. But my first challenge as a Jedi would be the liberation of Bespin from the clutches of the Imperial Remnant. Fortunately, Lando Calrissian would be along for the ride.|X2|<ref name="SWB:ES" />}}
The '''liberation of Bespin''' occurred [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] victory at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] when the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] was seized from the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Exploiting the Empire's state of disarray in the wake of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and information on Bespin's defenses leaked by Alliance sympathizers [[Willrow Hood/Legends|Willrow Hood]] and [[Tian Chyler]], the general, with the irregular unit known as "[[Lando's Commandos]]," launched a campaign dedicated to driving the Empire off of Bespin, culminating in the rescue of his former [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] by the [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]].

While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] inflicted heavy casualties among the remaining Imperial forces in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and its [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Lobot took control of the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems and reinstated Calrissian as its [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], the position he had been forced to abandon to escape Bespin's Imperial [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We must plan for every contingency. We must defend Endor now, and we've promised General Calrissian assistance with liberating Cloud City.''"<br />"''I talked to Lando on the comlink. He says he's got ideas of his own.|Gial Ackbar and Han Solo|<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>}}
Fleeing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[occupation of Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] left his position as [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> an installation [[Mining/Legends|mining]] the [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and fight in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Rebellion and Empire.<ref name="NEC" /> Working with his [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] former [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], and Bespin's [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] population, Calrissian [[Ugnaught rebellion|overthrew]] Cloud City's Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]].<ref name="SW57">[[Star Wars (1977) 57|''Star Wars'' (1977) 57]]</ref>

[[File:C_C_celebration.png|thumb|left|300px|The citizens of Cloud City celebrated in the wake of the Battle of Endor.]]
However, the Empire retook Bespin,<ref name="NEGTC" /> maintaining control of Cloud City until after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> in which Calrissian, by then a [[General/Legends|general]], led the Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] assault, destroying the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] over the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> After the battle, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] promised the general all the fighters the Alliance could spare, but with the Rebellion's resources occupied with the defense of the temporary Rebel [[Capital/Legends|capital]] at Endor and a [[Battle of Bakura|mission]] to the Imperial-held [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], Calrissian developed a plan of his own,<ref name="TAB" /> assembling a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] dubbed "[[Lando's Commandos]]" for the task.<ref name="CSWELC">{{CSWECite|II|243|Lando's Commandos}}</ref> Although he was briefly diverted to support his old friend and fellow Rebel [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in putting down an [[Black Sun civil war|attempted resurgence]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, the former Baron Administrator made Cloud City's freedom the focus of his attention, taking advantage of the Empire's confusion following the Battle of Endor.<ref name="NEGTC" />

On Cloud City, the population celebrated the Rebel victory at Endor with [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]] in a cheering demonstration.<ref name="ROTJ" /> With the Alliance gaining the upper hand in the war, disenfranchised [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Tian Chyler]] defected to the Rebellion, enlisting the aid of Alliance sympathizer [[Willrow Hood/Legends|Willrow Hood]] to turn over information on Cloud City's defenses,<ref name="WHITDB" /> which proved vital in the liberation of Bespin.<ref name="CITDB">{{DB|character|chyler|Chyler, Tian}}</ref>

==The liberation==
{{Quote|We need to free Lobot, X2. He's key to liberating Cloud City.|Lando Calrissian, to X2|<ref name="SWB:ES" />}}
In a [[Standard month/Legends|months]]-long campaign, Calrissian and his Commandos drove the remaining Imperial forces out of Cloud City.<ref name="NEGTC" /> In a final strike, the Alliance sought to free Lobot, who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] on Cloud City by the Imperials, and employ his skill with [[Computer/Legends|computers]] to take control of the [[City/Legends|city]]. A Rebel force composed of an [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]], multiple [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], and a group of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including the general and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]], engaged in an [[Space warfare/Legends|aerial battle]] with the occupying forces&mdash;an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], several [[Vindicator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Vindicator''-class heavy cruisers]], and their [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] complement. At Calrissian's direction, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] shot down a [[Tibanna gas platform]], causing it to plummet into and take out a ''Vindicator''-class [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. After eliminating a number of pursuing [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]], X2 brought his starfighter down to a landing platform and joined General Calrissian on the colony's surface.<ref name="SWB:ES" />

[[File:Bespin_darktroopers_BES.jpg|thumb|right|300px|An Imperial landing craft deploying Dark troopers]]
Making their way to a [[computer terminal]], the clone Jedi engaged [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] forces while the general determined the location of Lobot. Passing through a [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing chamber]] to reach the cyborg's [[Prison/Legends|cell]], the Jedi escorted Lobot to the central computer, defending him from attack as he bypassed [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] defenses and gave Calrissian control of the city. A pair of [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] launched a counter-attack, deploying a stormtrooper detachment and six [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]] to landing pads on opposite sides of the complex. Both forces were defeated by X2, Calrissian, and Lobot, freeing Cloud City from Imperial control.<ref name="SWB:ES" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Great job, X2! Bespin is liberated. The people of Cloud City extend their heartfelt thanks. Drinks are on me!|Lando Calrissian to X2|<ref name="SWB:ES" />}}
Following his victory, Calrissian was once again Baron Administrator of Cloud City, while Lobot's expertise led the cyborg to take on the role in a de facto capacity. In approximately [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Calrissian's tenure would be cut short once again, losing Cloud City to [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="NEGTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The liberation of Bespin was first mentioned in the [[1993]] novel ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'' by [[Kathy Tyers]],<ref name="TAB" /> and it first appeared in the level "Bespin" of the [[2009]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''{{'s}} [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] version.<ref name="SWB:ES" /> The conflict received a name in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Tian Chyler, written by [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member "yoda's waiter"<ref name="CITDB" /> and published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2007]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27247743|board=Literature|thread=Official "What's the Story?" Hyperspace Databank Feature Discussion|user=[[Aidan Hennessy|QuentinGeorge]]|date=2007-03-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221221230512/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/official-whats-the-story-hyperspace-databank-feature-discussion.20434695/page-87}}</ref> Although ''Elite Squadron'' identifies Cloud City's occupying force as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]],<ref name="SWB:ES" /> this faction was established in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the liberation's date,<ref name="Date" /> and thus this article treats the reference as an error.
